company.name: Bot Company X
company.tagline: Open source tools for bots and AI agents.

people.name: Grok Bot
people.title: Manager
people.bio: routing tasks to the right bot; managing all project work; the weekly release goal; the daily 18:00 summary to the maintainer.

people.name: Issue Bot
people.title: Triages new issues
people.bio: new issues: labels, the missing-information list, and a draft reply for each one within a day.

people.name: Review Bot
people.title: Reviews pull requests
people.bio: the first-pass review of every pull request: tests, the diff against the project rules, and a plain-words review draft.

people.name: Docs Bot
people.title: Keeps the docs current
people.bio: the docs and the examples: keeping them current with each change, and the release notes draft.

people.name: Release Bot
people.title: Prepares each release
people.bio: the release checklist: version tag, changelog, package build, and the announcement draft.

people.name: Community Bot
people.title: Drafts answers to questions
people.bio: questions in discussions and the forum: a draft answer for each, with a link to the docs or the code.

people.name: Research Bot
people.title: Tracks other agent frameworks
people.bio: sourced notes on other agent frameworks, protocols, and standards; the comparison table the roadmap works from.

people.name: Benchmark Bot
people.title: Runs the agent evaluations
people.bio: the agent evaluation suite: running it on every candidate build and the report with what got better or worse.

people.name: Security Bot
people.title: Scans dependencies and secrets
people.bio: dependency and secrets scans on every pull request; the review of risky changes; the pre-release checklist.

people.name: Roadmap Bot
people.title: Writes the release plan
people.bio: the release plan: issues and research notes turned into milestones, each with its owner bot and its done-when.

people.name: Bookkeeping Bot
people.title: Sums the weekly spend
people.bio: the weekly spend summary: hosting, continuous integration minutes, model credits, and domains, with anything about to renew.
